definitions.gloss: moving out; vacating (a residence or property)
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving and giving up occupancy of a rented apartment, house, or other property.
The act of leaving or being made to leave a place, often due to danger or official orders.

notes:
FORMATION:
{退|たい} (withdraw, retreat) + {去|きょ} (leave, depart)

SENSE 1 (RENTAL CONTEXT):
Common in real estate and rental agreements:
・{退去|たいきょ}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧ - notice to vacate
・{退去|たいきょ}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧ - move-out date
・{退去|たいきょ}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ - move-out costs
・⟦{原状回復|げんじょうかいふく}→原状回復：23319_genjoukaifuku⟧ - restoring the original condition (often required by the ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ or ⟦{管理会社|かんりがいしゃ}→管理会社：23531_kanrigaisha⟧)

SENSE 2 (EVACUATION, REMOVAL):
・⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧{退去|たいきょ} - forced eviction; deportation
・{退去|たいきょ}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ - evacuation order
・{退去|たいきょ}⟦{勧告|かんこく}→勧告：05828_kankoku⟧ - evacuation advisory (weaker than an order)

REGISTER: Formal and administrative. Everyday speech about moving house uses ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引っ越し：noentry⟧ instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{立|た}ち{退|の}き→立ち退き：19092_tachinoki⟧ - eviction, vacating (usually forced, legal contexts)

ANTONYM:
・⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧ - moving in (to a residence)
